text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'fjordnet-dpool' node 10.4.12.7 reported GPU hot-unplug events (kernel panic candidate). Pager routed to #incidents @oncall-eng.

Anna Kline: I'm oncall — Ack. gathering heartbeat and recent logs. ETA 2m

Rafael Morales: Confirming ECC spike + nvlink errors. dmesg shows repeated:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=2104 ...
[ 1234.567891] NVRM: GPU at pci:65:00:0 may have been physically removed
```

Jamie Sun: BMC shows intermittent power events, last PMIC reset 35s ago. IPMI outputs:
```
ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-10.4.12.7 -U admin -P **** chassis power status
Chassis Power is on
ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-10.4.12.7 sdr list | grep -i gpu
GPU0 Temp | 96 degrees C | ns
```

Meena Patel: FjordNet jobs are failing with CUDA driver errors; 5% of their active shards impacted. CS advised to message FjordNet primary ops: "We're investigating; may schedule failover."

Anna Kline: Immediate mitigations I'm taking now:
- Cordon node 10.4.12.7 and start graceful drain for non-critical pods.
- Taint node with "dedpool-draining=fjordnet:NoSchedule" to prevent new allocations.

Command I ran:
```
kubectl cordon node-10-4-12-7
kubectl drain node-10-4-12-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60
kubectl taint nodes node-10-4-12-7 dedpool-draining=fjordnet:NoSchedule
```

Rafael Morales: Recommend promoting tenant to reserved-std pool while replacement is provisioned. Started model reroute jobs to reserved-std with lower concurrency.

Ryan Chen: I've kicked off a canary traffic shift for FjordNet: 20% traffic -> reserved-std. Monitoring p99 latency + error-rate.

Liam Torres (CS): Told FjordNet about canary shift and asked if they want immediate full failover. They asked to wait 10min while they check internal jobs.

Kris Hwang (hw-oncall): I'll attempt BMC soft-reset and request hotplug reseat sequence. Steps:
1) ipmitool mc reset cold
2) wait 60s
3) check NVMe/GPU enumerations

Jamie Sun: BMC soft-reset produced transient messages but node remains online. However nvlink still degraded. Hardware suggests swap GPU into spare slot or hot-swap enclosure; we've flagged for spare allocation.

Anna Kline: Because tenant has long-running jobs, we're doing a staged switchover: canary 20% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics OK. Also disabling preemption on their pods to avoid mid-run restarts. Commands:
```
kubectl patch pod <pod> -p '{"spec": {"priorityClassName": "system-cluster-critical"}}'
```

Rafael Morales: Patch applied to all fjordnet pods in podset-3. Also shrinking concurrency: scaling down replicaSets for non-critical tasks.

Meena Patel: FjordNet replied — accept full failover now. CS requested an incident summary and ETA for replacement node.

Kris Hwang: Spare node allocated from pool 'spare-hotplug-1'. Initiating join to cluster; running job to warm GPU cache and prepopulate KV caches for runtime.

Anna Kline: New node joined: node-10-4-20-2. Starting live migrations for critical pods using eviction and recreate strategy.

Command snippet for join verification:
```
kubectl get nodes | grep 10-4-20-2
node-10-4-20-2   Ready,SchedulingDisabled   4d   v1.26.3
```

Rafael Morales: After failover, FjordNet error-rate down to 0.8% from 5.2%. p99 latency stable. Can proceed to deprovision node-10-4-12-7 once diagnostics complete.

Jamie Sun: Collected full hardware logs and NVLINK diagnostic output; attached to internal ticket REDWOOD-HW-4576. Preliminary finding: PCIe riser intermittent contact + high GPU temp. Recommend RMA replacement of GPU riser and thermal pads replacement.

Anna Kline: Action items:
- Kris to RMA GPU riser and schedule maintenance window (hw-oncall)
- Rafael to run post-mortem template and link perf traces
- Meena/Liam to send customer incident summary + mitigations
- Ryan to revert canary routing once customer confirms stable

Liam Torres: Sending initial summary to FjordNet and including expected timeline: replacement parts 48-72h, node offline until RMA completed. They requested daily updates.

Anna Kline: Incident status -> mitigation: tenant fully failed over to reserved-std pool; customer impact minimized. Marking as "mitigated". Will keep thread open until RMA done and node fully replaced.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 3349001111 MITIGATED -> customer traffic rerouted. Severity downgraded to SEV3. Runbook: https://redwood.ops/runbooks/dedpool-hotplug

Rafael Morales: I'll own the postmortem. Assigning to myself and tagging eng-runtime + eng-sre. ETA for draft: 24h.

Meena Patel: Thanks team. Closing loop with FjordNet now. :thumbsup:

Anna Kline: Great work. Closing thread when RMA confirmed. :white_check_mark:
